What do you do?

Model. This side-view model assumes rigid bones and slow movement. Muscle demand is represented by the torque created at the joint: force × moment arm.

Muscles. “Glutes” represents all hip extensors, including assistance from the hamstrings. The calf and other muscles are omitted for simplicity.

Blue arrows. These show the forces you apply to the seat: pushing against the backrest and pulling on the handles, which brighten as you pull harder. The model includes body weight and a reference pushing force of twice your body weight.

Scope. This illustrates general trends, not measurements for an individual.
